newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stock index falls 1.13 pct on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stock index falls 1.13 pct on profit-taking.

text.p: Jakarta stock index fell 1.13 percent to 729.82 points in early afternoon on Thursday on continued profit-taking, brokers said.
"We had actually expected the correction to come in last Monday, but a deregulation package had delayed profit-taking," Vera Marpaung, a broker with Asian Development Securities said.

Indonesia announced an economic deregulation package on Monday by cutting import tariffs on 1,600 items. The stock market hit several record highs prior to the reform package, making it inevitable for a widespread profit-taking.
Marpaung said the sharp fall of Dow Jones index overnight had triggered investors to cash out.
Correction was seen mainly in Telkom, Semen Gresik, Indocement and Indosat.
Brokers said profit-taking in blue-chip counters did not prevent local players from speculating in second liners.
